pr_body:
Fixes #13499

Add ETag header to cache control. This saves some cpu cycles on the server side and skips transfers for cached files.

![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1666336/114197328-8274e900-9952-11eb-8339-9e5293925d4b.png)
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1666336/114197462-a9cbb600-9952-11eb-8330-3d650dcf2c56.png)

issue_context.title: Disable Browser Caching for RAW view

## Description
Because of browser caching (in this case Firefox 82.0.2), the RAW file view may not represent the actual file content when Edit was done in browser beforehand.

The first screenshot shows what was saved, the second is Raw view.

It can be solved by clearing the cache of the browser, but is it possible to solve this on the server side?
...

comments: It might make sense to version these files with `Etag`, as we do in codeberg pages: https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/build-deploy-gitea/src/branch/master/var/www/pages/index.php#L146, so that they are cached, but the cache is invalidated with a new commit.

review_comments: Is it ok to move `IncreaseDownloadCount` up? Now the download is counted even if an error may occur. In the old code the redirect or `ServeData` may fail too.

This seems like a worthwile change as [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/ETag) seems strict about these quotes. I was under the impression that it did work before so maybe some browsers do not strictly require them.
Would add the quotes here instead. This is important because `generateETag` does not add them.
On the other hand, this would prevent weak validators (`W/"value"`) from being used. So probably better to add the quotes in `generateETag`.
